name: Knova
tagline: An offline AI tutor for elementary students that builds lessons from photos of their materials.
problem: Many students lose access to learning when internet or power drops, the team says.
solution: Gemma runs on the device through ZETIC to generate structured lessons from photos or text, Bayesian knowledge tracing adapts content, and native text-to-speech works offline.
demo_moment: Team-described: in airplane mode, photograph a worksheet and get a lesson.

lessons: Turning off the network on stage proves an on-device claim.
